title: Kinetic Typography lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 7 comps the round-2 Kinetic Typography templates were built and verified in: lower third, split title, highlight sweep, quote, stat punch, numbered list and follow end card.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 kinetic-type template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.
parameters: highlight words (regenerate: positions come from cc.textw)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (klt_, kst_, khs_, kqt_, ksp_, knl_, kec_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/kinetic_type_lab2.py writes the comps (needs Pillow for cc.textw); apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
